replaces.previous: assets/models/light-lod.glb (iteration 03; file kept unchanged, no longer referenced by the manifest)

diagnosis.symptom: User feedback iteration 04: "Overhead lights textures look messed up / mangled".
diagnosis.cause: light-lod.glb = meshoptimizer simplifySloppy on positions only over light.glb. light.glb UVs are a ~760-chart box-projection atlas; sloppy clustering merges vertices across chart seams and reuses one arbitrary original vertex (with its UV) per cluster, so output triangles sample unrelated atlas charts.

light-lod.glb (iteration 03).verdict: mangled: triangles span multiple atlas charts; unused vertices also kept

diagnosis.evidence: qa-artifacts/assets/light-lod-iteration04/compare.png + metrics.json (CPU renders: front, below 3/4, straight below)

source.note: same dense master as iteration-01 light.glb; read-only

conventions.origin: top centre (y=0 is the top/mounting face; fixture hangs down to negative y; x/z bbox centre)
conventions.transform: identity orientation (as light.glb), uniform scale 1.385612 to 1.2 m length, translation 0.000528,-0.096583,0.00052

steps.tool: lib/dense.mjs simplifyGeometry (meshoptimizer simplify, Permissive, weld by position)
lib/unwrap.mjs (fresh box-projection atlas; no UV reused from light.glb)
lib/bake.mjs (closest same-facing dense-source surface; colour, packed metallic-roughness, tangent-space normal)

steps.detail: baseColor JPEG q86 4:4:4, metallicRoughness JPEG q90, normal PNG; plain glTF 2.0 binary

limitations: Source is an unapproved AI reconstruction; inferred hidden surfaces. Prototype derivative, not approved art, no license clearance asserted.
Simplified from 979562 to 894 triangles (max error ~6.8 mm); small fasteners/strap relief survive only in the baked normal/colour maps.
Provisional 1.2 m length chosen in iteration 01, not measured/approved.
